name: Retrospective
description: Sprint or project retrospective template for reflecting on what went well, what could improve, and action items.

sections.title: What Went Well
sections.instruction: List the practices, achievements, and positive outcomes from the sprint or project phase.

sections.title: What Could Improve
sections.instruction: List the challenges, pain points, and areas where the team struggled or processes broke down.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners and due date. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp in the table.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Kudos & Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize team shout-outs, individual recognitions, and notable highlights from the period.
